title: Shop — SLO Overview
description: Availability and latency SLOs per service: error budget, burn rates and alerts.

list.name: Critical alerts
list.expr: max by (alertname, job, deployment, slo) (ALERTS{alertname=~"Shop.*", alertstate="firing", severity="critical"})

list.name: Node restarts
list.expr: (max by (node) (label_replace(node_boot_time_seconds, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.+):[0-9]+") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)) > max_over_time((max by (node) (label_replace(node_boot_time_seconds, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.+):[0-9]+") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)))[30m:1m] offset 1m)) * on (node) group_left (label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool, label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning) max by (node, label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool, label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning) (kube_node_labels)
list.textFormat: Pool {{label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool}} ({{label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning}}): spot preemption, upgrade or repair; its pods were rescheduled

list.name: Container restarts
list.expr: (changes(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="shop"}[1m]) > 0) * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left (reason) max by (namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace="shop"})

panels.title: Checkout · 5m
panels.description: Share of checkout requests answered without a 5xx at the edge, including failures of every service behind it.

panels.title: Browse · 5m
panels.description: Share of browse requests answered without a 5xx at the edge, including failures of every service behind it.

panels.title: Journey SLOs
panels.description: What users experience. A service that is down loses its own SLI (it receives no requests), but the journeys that depend on it keep burning here.

targets.expr: sum by (job, slo) (slo:sli_error:ratio_rate1h{kind="journey"} / on (job, slo, kind) (1 - slo:objective:ratio))
sum by (job, slo) (slo:sli_error:ratio_rate6h{kind="journey"} / on (job, slo, kind) (1 - slo:objective:ratio))

sum by (job, slo) (clamp_max(clamp_min(slo:error_budget_remaining:ratio{kind="journey"}, 0) * 2592000 / on (job, slo, kind) (slo:sli_error:ratio_rate1h{kind="journey"} / on (job, slo, kind) (1 - slo:objective:ratio)), 31536000))

panels.title: Services without ready pods
panels.description: A service with no ready pod is down even though its SLO rows stay quiet. Alert: ShopServiceDown.

panels.title: Lowest error budget
panels.description: The journey or service SLO with the least error budget left in the 30-day window. Below 0 it is violated; under 25% only a short incident remains before it is.

panels.title: SLO data in window
panels.description: How much data the 30-day window really holds. Below 30 days (e.g. a recently created cluster), budget figures describe only this period and a short incident looks much larger.

panels.title: SLO rules last evaluated
panels.description: Age of the newest SLI sample. If vmalert or the metrics storage is down, the dashboard silently goes stale.

panels.title: Availability — requests answered without a 5xx
panels.description: Each service's share of non-5xx responses over 30 days against its objective. Burn rate 1 spends the budget in exactly 30 days; alerts page at 14.4 (1h) or 6 (6h). Budget gone in = remaining budget at the current 1h burn rate. Sorted by budget remaining, the most at risk first. Click a service to drill down.

targets.expr: sum by (job, slo) (slo:sli_error:ratio_rate1h{kind="service", slo="availability"} / on (job, slo, kind) (1 - slo:objective:ratio))
sum by (job, slo) (slo:sli_error:ratio_rate6h{kind="service", slo="availability"} / on (job, slo, kind) (1 - slo:objective:ratio))

sum by (job, slo) (clamp_max(clamp_min(slo:error_budget_remaining:ratio{kind="service", slo="availability"}, 0) * 2592000 / on (job, slo, kind) (slo:sli_error:ratio_rate1h{kind="service", slo="availability"} / on (job, slo, kind) (1 - slo:objective:ratio)), 31536000))

panels.title: Latency — requests faster than the service's threshold
panels.description: Each service's share of requests answered within its threshold (Threshold column) over 30 days against its objective. Burn rate 1 spends the budget in exactly 30 days; alerts page at 14.4 (1h) or 6 (6h). Budget gone in = remaining budget at the current 1h burn rate. Sorted by budget remaining, the most at risk first. Click a service to drill down.

targets.expr: sum by (job, slo) (slo:sli_error:ratio_rate1h{kind="service", slo="latency"} / on (job, slo, kind) (1 - slo:objective:ratio))
sum by (job, slo) (slo:sli_error:ratio_rate6h{kind="service", slo="latency"} / on (job, slo, kind) (1 - slo:objective:ratio))

sum by (job, slo) (clamp_max(clamp_min(slo:error_budget_remaining:ratio{kind="service", slo="latency"}, 0) * 2592000 / on (job, slo, kind) (slo:sli_error:ratio_rate1h{kind="service", slo="latency"} / on (job, slo, kind) (1 - slo:objective:ratio)), 31536000))

panels.title: Burn rate — 1h window
panels.description: Pages when both the 1h and 5m burn rates exceed 14.4 (2% of the 30-day budget in one hour).

panels.title: Burn rate — 6h window
panels.description: Pages when both the 6h and 30m burn rates exceed 6 (5% of the 30-day budget in six hours).

panels.title: Journey SLIs — 1h
panels.description: Share of good requests over the last hour (checkout and browse, measured at api-gateway): availability = not 5xx, latency = faster than the threshold. The dashed lines are the objectives; below them the error budget is spent faster than planned. The axis stops at 95%: lines leaving it at the bottom are incidents (Min in the legend). Definitions at the bottom.

panels.title: Service SLIs — 1h
panels.description: Share of good requests over the last hour (each service's own requests): availability = not 5xx, latency = faster than the threshold. The dashed lines are the objectives; below them the error budget is spent faster than planned. The axis stops at 95%: lines leaving it at the bottom are incidents (Min in the legend). Definitions at the bottom.

panels.title: Error budget remaining (30d)
panels.description: Below 0 the SLO is violated for the 30-day window.

panels.title: Bad requests ratio — 5m
panels.description: Share of requests that are 5xx (availability) or slower than the threshold (latency).

panels.title: Shop alerts — firing and pending
panels.description: Alert state written by vmalert (ALERTS series). Burn-rate alerts carry the job and slo labels.

options.content:
| SLI | Good events | Valid events | Objective (30 days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Availability** | responses that are not 5xx (4xx are the client's mistake and count as good) | all HTTP requests | 99.5% |
| **Latency** | responses faster than the latency threshold | all HTTP requests | 99% |

**Where they are measured.** *Journeys* at the edge (api-gateway), so they include failures of every service behind it:
**checkout** = `POST /api/orders` (threshold 500 ms); **browse** = `GET /api/products/ or /api/users/` (threshold 100 ms).
*Services* on each service's own requests (threshold 100 ms;
api-gateway, order-service, payment-service: 500 ms:
the checkout path includes the payment provider).

**Error budget and burn rate.** Budget = 1 − objective over a rolling 30 days. Burn rate = error ratio / budget: 1 spends
the budget in exactly 30 days. Pages (critical): burn rate above 14.4 over 1h and 5m, or above 6 over 6h and 30m.
Tickets (warning): above 3 over 1d and 2h, or above 1 over 3d and 6h. Recording rules: `apps/k8s/services/templates/monitoring.yaml`.
